purpose: Refine the historical policy/effect finding after repository-wide counterhypothesis search, avoiding the false stronger claim that historical Project-Frankenstein had no enforcement mechanisms at all.

authority_snapshot.evidence_boundary: static source/search at pinned historical repository head only

counterhypothesis_test.hypothesis: An external repository caller may invoke ProjectEngine.check_policy() before project tool execution.
counterhypothesis_test.test: Repository-wide code search for check_policy at pinned current historical head.
counterhypothesis_test.result: Only services/project_engine.py was returned; no second repository call site was found.
counterhypothesis_test.promotion: The specific external-check_policy-wrapper counterhypothesis is falsified at this repository snapshot.
counterhypothesis_test.remaining_alternative: Other independently implemented enforcement paths may exist without calling check_policy().

semantic_atoms.claim: Repository-wide code search at Project-Frankenstein 39c5423e0bfae54b971aab0be82f225f7a5890b8 finds check_policy only in services/project_engine.py. No repository call site consuming that specific policy decider was observed.
semantic_atoms.scope_note: Search evidence can miss dynamically constructed/reflection-based calls; the claim is bounded to accessible static repository code at the pinned head.

semantic_atoms.claim: agentic/executor.py implements a separate ToolExecutor approval/risk path: execute() checks _needs_approval unless skip_approval is set, and provides additional code/bash guardrails and sandboxing. This is an enforcement mechanism independent of ProjectEngine.check_policy().

agentic/loop.py explicitly calls ToolExecutor.execute(..., skip_approval=True) for tools in a local safe-auto-approve set and after explicit user approval for other tools. Therefore ToolExecutor's internal approval check is not a sole unconditional effect gate; upstream classification/approval logic participates in authority.

The pinned historical repository exposes multiple non-identical effect-control mechanisms: ProjectEngine has project_policies/check_policy plus separate direct-path blocking/sandbox logic, while the agentic ToolExecutor/AgentLoop has independent risk approval and guardrails. The source does not establish one canonical policy-to-effect authority edge shared by all effect paths.
semantic_atoms.falsifier: A pinned architecture entrypoint or shared wrapper proving that all externally effectful paths converge through one canonical enforcement decision before execution.

correction_to_prior_packet.preserved: ProjectEngine.check_policy presence does not establish its consumption by the direct ProjectEngine tool path.
correction_to_prior_packet.refined: Do not generalize this to 'no historical enforcement'. Independent agentic approval/guardrail enforcement exists in the same repository.
correction_to_prior_packet.new_architecture_problem: fragmented/non-unified effect authority rather than total absence of guards

failure_atlas_proposal.failure_pattern: Policy state/decision logic and concrete effect guards exist in different planes, while the repository does not demonstrate one canonical fail-closed edge consumed by every effect path.
failure_atlas_proposal.frankenstein2_rule: Every real effect must converge through one canonical deterministic authorization edge; path-specific safety checks may narrow further but may not create independent competing authorities.

grid10_frankenstein2_delta: Model the donor/historical effect layer as fragmented roles, not as one inherited EffectGate simply because several guard-like functions exist.
For Frankenstein 2.0, require explicit convergence of policy/capability authority, invocation identity, hard pre-effect blocking, effect journaling, and postcondition verification.
Test each effect ingress class independently and then prove convergence; a safe agentic executor does not prove the project-engine path is gated, and vice versa.
Keep path-local safety guards as defense in depth beneath the canonical effect authority, not as alternate sources of permission.
next_exact_gate: Enumerate all effectful historical entry classes at the pinned Project-Frankenstein head and build a path-to-guard matrix; then merge the verified fragmentation result into FAILURE_ATLAS.json and EMERGENT_COUPLING_GRAPH.json and hand the single-authority requirement to Triggerword 4.
